snippet.title: VirtualSociety, Build Living Worlds - Official Gameplay Trailer - New life simulation game
snippet.description:
Build more than beautiful places. Build worlds that live.

VirtualSociety is a cozy creative sandbox life simulation where you can build places, create characters, design interactions, and turn your ideas into living, playable worlds.

From a quiet home to a lively café, decide who lives there, what they do, and what can happen next. Give characters their own routines, create stories and events, and use visual scripting to make objects, places, and people react to each other.

Explore your creations on your own, build together with friends, and share the worlds you bring to life.

This new gameplay trailer offers a closer look at the characters, environments, and creative possibilities of VirtualSociety.
⭐ Wishlist VirtualSociety on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856980/VirtualSociety
💜 Support the project on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/virtualsociety
💬 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/xeqzaWkbe2
🌍 Discover VirtualSociety: https://virtualsociety.co

VirtualSociety is currently in development for PC and mobile.
#VirtualSociety #lifesim #lifesimulation  #CozyGames #sandbox 

Musical arrangement by Zack Pedretti
